Behavior expert Chase Hughes joins Joe Rogan for episode 2515. Hughes trains people to read body cues and spot lies. His work draws on military and police methods.

Rogan asks how anyone can tell truth from performance in real time. Hughes explains tells, baselines, and common traps in reading people. He warns that no sign works alone or always. The episode gives wary listeners a toolkit and its limits. It pairs well with Rogan's long interest in how minds work under stress, charm, and deceit. Rogan tests each claim like a good skeptic.
